recommendation: Keep the commit. Future authoritative SupplyRequest resource-page edits should be made in HL7/oo-incubator, while active core module references should stay aligned with that external source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request to update SupplyRequest Scope and Usage so the request of supplies used in the healthcare process is described as being delivered to a particular location.
initial_application: FHIR-39509 was already applied to the retained SupplyRequest introduction by commit 94e4f4c06f1d1aef0dbd9f5b8ccdbbb1af0bf0fe, followed by typo fix 125fd027345c3417618377d5c7e1114125e7f235; both the retained local resource page and current OO Incubator source contain the approved sentence.
additional_context: OO minutes show the request was one of four SupplyRequest updates approved together. The current core build no longer owns the SupplyRequest resource page because SupplyRequest was removed from active fhir.ini lists and redirected to the OO Incubator IG, but the active core Medications module still summarized SupplyRequest with the old pre-FHIR-39509 phrase.
reconciliation: Changed source/medications-module.html so the active core summary now says SupplyRequest/SupplyDelivery concern requests of supplies used in healthcare to be delivered to a particular location; no dormant SupplyRequest or external OO Incubator source edit was needed.
source_changes: source/medications-module.html: added the approved 'to be delivered to a particular location' scope phrase to the active SupplyRequest/SupplyDelivery summary.
